messages:
Maya: Quick design review for the Private setup wizard network step. Proposal: move the main preflight button into the card header, show a small status chip (dot + text) inline, and keep detailed logs hidden behind a 'details' expander. Also consider an advanced flyout for MTU/ports instead of inline fields. Screenshot mock attached.

Jin: Button copy: prefer clearer label like 'Run network preflight' instead of just 'Run preflight'. Users skim. :point_up: 

Alex: Flyout UX: it should be dismissible with Esc + backdrop click. Don't trap focus unless user opens an explicit modal. If we use a flyout, ensure it is announced when opened.

Priya: A11y notes: if we add a live status chip, give it an aria-label (e.g. 'preflight status: running'). Use aria-live="polite" for streamed updates and debounce announcements so screen readers aren't spammed. Also ensure color is not the only status cue.

Rafael: Backend: preflight produces per-check results and can stream partial updates. UI states we should model: idle -> running(streaming) -> complete (success|partial|fail). We'll emit a final summary event with counts.

Maya: Copy variants for failure banner:
- Option A: "Some network checks failed. Try these quick fixes:"
- Option B: "Network preflight found issues — common causes: VPN, firewall rules, incorrect CIDR."
I prefer A with short actionable bullets.

Jin: +1 for actionable bullets. Add CTAs: 'Retry checks', 'Download diagnostics' (link), 'Contact support' (opens modal pre-filled). Keep CTAs concise.

Alex: Visual/contrast nit: failure banner must meet AA contrast. Use icon + bold headline and explicit text like "Status: 2 failed" so color isn't required to understand it.

Priya: Keyboard flow: expander and the chip must be focusable. expander should have aria-expanded and aria-controls attributes. When details are opened, focus should move into the first interactive element inside (e.g., 'Retry' button).

Rafael: For the logs view we can show a truncated set and add a 'Show more' to expand into a scrollable block. Sample mock lines for design: 
```
tcp_probe 10.0.0.5:443 OK
dns_test example.com -> NXDOMAIN
egress 8.8.8.8:53 TIMEOUT
```
Add a 'retry failing checks' action next to each failing line in the expanded view.

Maya: Microcopy suggestion under main action: "This runs outbound probes from our nodes to your VPC. No credentials or configuration are uploaded." Keeps trust minimal and clear.

Jin: Also add a tiny 'last updated' timestamp near the status chip so users know when results arrived. Debounce streaming updates to ~200-300ms to reduce UI churn.

Alex: Continue behaviour: allow 'Save & continue' even if there are warnings, but present a confirmation modal with a checkbox: "I understand the risks". For hard failures block continuing.

Priya: Avoid jargon in copy. Replace 'egress' with 'outbound' and expand acronyms on hover. Provide a short tooltip explaining what each check does.

infra-bot: deploy:preflight-service v1.5 deployed to staging 1:32 UTC 197211234. Streaming endpoint: /staging/api/preflight/stream

Rafael: I'll share the streaming event schema tomorrow. We'll include fields: check_id, status, short_message, raw_log, timestamp. UI team: please confirm you can handle 'partial' as a state.

Maya: Thanks all. I'll update the figma file with the header button, chip, and details expander and post copy options for review. Rafael/Jin — can we sync 10am PT tomorrow for the payload? Ping @Priya afterwards for accessibility sign-off. :sparkles:
